skipped.note: The "Benefits of PPS include" list prints "Melting temperatures (Tm) of 285°C" and "Glass Transition temperature (Tg) of 85°C": statements about PPS the polymer, with no method or product scope, beside the registered TDS's product Tg of 83 °C; the reader proposed them as measurements and the reviewer rejected both. The annealing instructions are post-processing for PPS parts, not a column of the profile.
